name: Jellyfin2PopFeed (Beta)
description: Beta channel for Jellyfin2PopFeed - test upcoming features without affecting your stable install. Same plugin, side-by-side with the stable version.
overview: Beta: auto-log watched movies to Popfeed diary

versions.changelog: Beta: TV series support. FIX: TMDb ID now read from Series, not Episode. Auto-add to Currently Watching, auto-move to Watched on season end. Poster blob upload. Config toggle for TV shows.
Beta: TV series support (first build). Auto-add to Currently Watching, auto-move to Watched on season end. Known issue: TMDb ID read from Episode instead of Series.
Beta starting point. Matches stable v1.1.1. New features will be added here.
